sources: Day, Muise, Joel & Impett (2015), To do it or not to do it? How communally motivated people navigate sexual interdependence dilemmas, Personality and Social Psychology Bulletin 41(6), 791–804 – three studies (experiment, recall, 21-day couples diary); about 80% could recall a recent time their partner wanted sex and they did not; people high in sexual communal strength were more willing to engage when their own desire was low, and they and their partners reported higher relationship and sexual satisfaction. Authors stress this applies to freely chosen, consensual sex – not coercion or ignoring one's own needs.
Muise (2015), When your partner wants to do it and you don't, Psychology Today (summary by a co-author).
